contexts.text: He was uncovered in the midst of his tent () = things thereby perverted... For he is called uncovered, or naked, from the drunkenness of wine, in whom there are no truths of faith, and still more he in whom they are perverted. Explained... By its being said that he lay uncovered, is signified that he stripped himself of the truths of faith by wanting to investigate them by sensuous things and the derivative reasonings. Illustrated. ( = evils from the lack of truth in worship. AC 9960:16.)
